final: WITH rating_rates AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(price_per_day) AS mean_price_per_day FROM rating_rates) SELECT AVG(r.price_per_day) AS avg_price_per_day, AVG(r.price_per_day - o.mean_price_per_day) AS avg_difference FROM rating_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_price_per_day IS NOT NULL AND r.price_per_day > o.mean_price_per_day
